title: Snowflake
author: sisaloofafump
rules:
RULES:

Sudoku: Normal sudoku rules apply.

Diagonals: Digits cannot repeat on each of the marked diagonals. Portions of the diagonals are sequence lines (dark purple); along these lines, adjacent digits must increase by consistent number. For example 1-2-3 or 2-5-8. The different lines do not necessarily increase by the same amount.

Quadruples: Digits in the white circles must appear in the surrounding cells.

Parity lines: Adjacent digits along the light blue parity lines must alternate odd/even.

Even/odd: Cells shaded with a grey circle are odd. Cells with a grey square are even.

X: Digits separated by an X sum to 10.

My first published puzzle :D Tho it's not really appropriate for the current fall season. Hope you enjoy!
